dependencies.title: bh-1: contract: Result, source and tick types, JSON codec
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
The one shared contract every other sprint codes against: the package skeleton, `Ok | Err` with the error union, the plain types each source module returns, the tick and detail-file types, and the JSON codec. Small on purpose: it unblocks bh-3..bh-8 and bh-10 in parallel.

## Deliverables
1. Package `apps/atm-bd-console/`: pyproject.toml (python >=3.11; deps rich, textual, sc-observability>=1.5.0; dev deps pytest, ruff; script `atm-bd-console = atm_bd_console.cli:main`), `__init__.py` with `__version__`; `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check` work. Platform: macOS and Linux (bh-7 uses `fcntl`).
2. `result.py` and `types.py` exactly as the design (field names and literals verbatim), plus `MergeFile`, `PrsFile`, `ActionLine` from the detail-file table. Frozen dataclasses and type aliases only; no logic, no I/O.
3. `codec.py`: `to_json`, `from_json` and `snapshot_stale` per the design's wire format.
4. `tests/conftest.py`: a `fake_bin(tmp_path, name, script)` fixture that puts a recording fake executable first on PATH (argv log + canned stdout/exit); every source sprint uses it.
5. `tests/fixtures/contract/`: one JSON file per detail file and per Snapshot shape (running, stopped closed, stopped idle, gh off, gh Err), written with `to_json` from populated instances. They are shape fixtures: consumers (bh-8, bh-10) render them; producers own their own goldens.
6. `tests/test_boundaries.py`, the one ownership test: only `atm_source.py`, `beads_source.py`, `git_source.py`, `github_source.py` and `status.py` import `subprocess`; `model.py`, `dispatch.py`, `render.py` and `prs.py` import no `*_source` module; no file under `src/` exceeds 1000 lines; no `bd list --all` string under `src/`. Modules not written yet are skipped.

## Does Not Close
- any source module, rule, renderer or CLI (bh-2..bh-10).
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) `uv run pytest -q` and `uv run ruff check src tests` pass on the skeleton; `atm-bd-console` script entry is declared.
- [ ] (D2) `types.py` and `result.py` define every name in the design with the same fields and literals (a test imports each name); `grep -nE 'raise|subprocess|open\(|def ' result.py types.py` finds nothing.
- [ ] (D3) Round-trip test over one populated instance of every type including `Ok`/`Err` of each Error kind; a naive datetime, a wrong Literal and a missing field each give `Err(ParseFailed)` naming the field path; a local-time datetime is written in UTC with `Z`; `snapshot_stale` is false at 2 × interval and true one second later.
- [ ] (D4) A test uses `fake_bin` and reads back the recorded argv.
- [ ] (D5) Every contract fixture parses back with `from_json` into its type.
- [ ] (D6) `test_boundaries.py` fails on a planted `import subprocess` in a temp copy of `model.py` and on a planted 1001-line file.

## Validation
- `cd apps/atm-bd-console && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src tests`

dependencies.title: bh-2: bead-queues as a snapshot viewer, install check
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
bead-queues stops computing queues: it becomes a thin front for `atm-bd-console show`, which owns the snapshot reading, the staleness rule and the rendering (ANC-002). It never starts the console. The package install checks the app and mmdflux are installed.

## Deliverables
1. bead-queues `--phase <x>` runs `atm-bd-console show --phase <x>` and passes its stdout and exit code through unchanged; all its queue logic is deleted. It never runs the console loop (`--once` or the app). When `atm-bd-console` is not on PATH it prints the install command and exits 2.
2. Its cron mode (`--json`, its state file under `.atm-bd/bead-queues/`) is removed; SKILL.md names `atm-bd-console --once --headless --phase <x> --as <lead>` as the cron and `bead-queues --phase <x>` as the viewer; no other plugin file references the removed cron mode.
3. install.py checks `atm-bd-console --version` against `REQUIRED_CONSOLE_VERSION` (a constant in install.py, set to the console's `__version__` released with this phase, 0.1.0) and `mmdflux --version` (>=2.6.1, used by the Status tab), and fails naming whichever is missing or too old with its install command: `uv tool install <atm-bd-orchestration repo>/apps/atm-bd-console` and `brew install kevinswiber/mmdflux/mmdflux` or `cargo install mmdflux`.
4. Minor version bump in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `manifest.yaml` and `test_install.py`'s expected version; CHANGELOG entry naming the bead-queues change and the install checks.

## Does Not Close
- `atm-bd-console show` itself (bh-9); the app (bh-1, bh-3..bh-10).
dependencies.design:
## Notes
Tested with `fake_bin` style fakes in the plugin tests (a fake `atm-bd-console` recording argv and returning canned stdout/exit); it does not import the app package.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) With a fake `atm-bd-console` returning canned output and exit 0, then exit 2, bead-queues prints that output and exits with the same code; the fake records exactly `show --phase <x>`; `grep -nE 'bd (list|ready|show)' bead-queues` finds nothing.
- [ ] (D1) `atm-bd-console` absent from PATH: bead-queues prints the install command and exits 2.
- [ ] (D2) SKILL.md contains the cron command string `atm-bd-console --once --headless --phase <x> --as <lead>`; bead-queues has no `--json` cron mode and no `.atm-bd/bead-queues/` state file; `grep -rn 'bead-queues.*--json' plugins/atm-bd-orchestration` finds nothing.
- [ ] (D3) install.py fails with the install command when `atm-bd-console` is missing, older than `REQUIRED_CONSOLE_VERSION`, or `mmdflux` is missing or older than 2.6.1; passes when both are current (fakes on PATH).
- [ ] (D4) plugin.json, manifest.yaml and test_install.py carry the same new version; CHANGELOG has its entry; `gen_manifest.py --check` passes.

## Validation
- `cd plugins/atm-bd-orchestration && python3.11 -m pytest -q tests skills && python3.11 tests/gen_manifest.py --check`

dependencies.title: bh-3: ATM source: members, tasks, presence, send, assign
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
Every ATM read and write behind one module, returning bh-1 types. If ATM's CLI changes, only this file changes.

## Deliverables
1. `members(team) -> Result[tuple[Member, ...]]` from `atm members --json` (fields used: `name`, `state`, `state_changed_at`): presence from `state` (`active`, `idle`, `offline`, `blocked`, else `unknown`), `presence_since` from `state_changed_at`. Roles are not read from the roster (recipients come from repo config and `--as`).
2. `tasks(team) -> Result[tuple[Task, ...]]` from `atm task list --all --json` (fields used: the task id, agent, state, `assigned_at`, `updated_at` and description, names as in the recorded fixture), queue order kept as `position`; `state_since` from `updated_at` (atm reports no start time).
3. `send(to, text, as_)` (`atm send <to> --as <as_> --stdin`, body on stdin) and `assign(agent, task_id, spec: DispatchSpec, as_)` (`atm task assign <agent> --as <as_> --task-id <id> --template <spec.template> --vars <file>`, vars written to a temp file outside the repo and removed after) -> `Result[None]`.
4. Every failure is an `Err` (`CommandFailed` with stderr, `Timeout`, `ParseFailed`), each with its `fix`; nothing raises; a 20 s timeout per call.

## Does Not Close
- deciding what to send (bh-6); calling it (bh-9).
dependencies.design:
## Notes
Fixtures are recorded `atm members --json` / `atm task list --all --json` outputs (current atm-dev roster, trimmed). ATM's own field names stop here; bh-1's `test_boundaries.py` enforces that only this module runs `atm`.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) Recorded roster fixture maps to Members with every presence value, including `blocked` and an unknown state -> `unknown`, and `presence_since` from `state_changed_at`.
- [ ] (D2) Recorded task-list fixture maps to Tasks in queue order with `position` 0..n and `state_since` = `updated_at`.
- [ ] (D3) `send` runs exactly `atm send <to> --as <as_> --stdin` and the fake receives the body on stdin; `assign` runs exactly the design argv and the vars file holds the spec's vars and is gone afterwards.
- [ ] (D4) Nonzero exit, invalid JSON and a fake sleeping past the timeout (timeout injected as 1 s in the test) each return the matching `Err`; `grep -n raise atm_source.py` finds nothing.

## Validation
- `cd apps/atm-bd-console && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src tests`

metadata.target_boundary: apps/atm-bd-console atm_source.py: the only module that runs atm

dependencies.title: bh-5: git and GitHub sources: refs, merge check, worktrees, open PRs
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
Every git and GitHub call behind two modules, returning bh-1 types. GitHub failing or off never stops work (ANC-017).

## Deliverables
1. `git_source.py`: `fetch(repo) -> Result[None]` (`git fetch origin --prune`), `remote_refs(repo) -> Result[tuple[RemoteRef, ...]]` (one `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:lstrip=3) %(objectname)' refs/remotes/origin`), `worktrees(repo) -> Result[tuple[Worktree, ...]]` (`git worktree list --porcelain`, detached -> branch None), `merge(repo, branch, target) -> Result[Merge]` with `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only -z origin/<target> origin/<branch>`: exit 0 clean, 1 conflict with the NUL-separated files and conflict messages, else `Err` (ANC-015).
2. `github_source.py`: `open_prs(mode) -> tuple[Result[tuple[PullRequest, ...]], GhStatus]`. Exactly one call per read (ANC-006). `graphql`: one `gh api graphql` query `pullRequests(states: OPEN, first: 100)` with `totalCount`: number, url, head, base, head sha, the head commit's `statusCheckRollup.state` and the names of its contexts whose conclusion/state is FAILURE, ERROR, CANCELLED or TIMED_OUT. `rest`: one `gh api 'repos/<o>/<r>/pulls?state=open&per_page=100'`; CI is `none` for every PR (REST trades CI for the single call). `off`: no call, `GhStatus(mode="off", ok=None)`. 20 s timeout.
3. Mapping (GitHub names stop here): rollup SUCCESS -> `success`; PENDING, EXPECTED -> `pending`; FAILURE, ERROR -> `failure`; null -> `none`. Truncation: graphql `totalCount` > 100, rest 100 rows returned -> `GhStatus.truncated=True`. Failures: timeout -> `Timeout`; HTTP 401/403 and 5xx in gh's stderr -> `Rejected(status)`; no connectivity (`error connecting`, DNS) -> `Unreachable`; anything else nonzero -> `CommandFailed`; bad JSON -> `ParseFailed`; each with `GhStatus(ok=False, error=...)`.

## Does Not Close
- when to call them (bh-6 `Due`); calling them (bh-9).
dependencies.design:
## Notes
git is tested on a real temporary repo with a bare `origin` (real git, no fake): clean and conflicting branches, a detached worktree. GitHub is tested with fake `gh` returning recorded GraphQL and REST bodies (trimmed from randlee/atm-core) and failure exits.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) Temp repo: `fetch` then `remote_refs` lists the pushed branches with their shas; `worktrees` lists the main and a detached worktree (branch None); clean branch -> `Merge(state="clean")`; conflicting branch -> `conflict` with the right file list; missing branch -> `Err`.
- [ ] (D2) Recorded GraphQL body -> PullRequests with ci and failed check names; `graphql` and `rest` each make exactly 1 call per read, `off` 0 (fake gh records calls); a body with `totalCount: 101` sets `truncated`, as does a 100-row REST body.
- [ ] (D3) Rollup states SUCCESS, PENDING, EXPECTED, FAILURE, ERROR and null map per the table.
- [ ] (D3) Fake gh timing out (timeout injected as 1 s), exiting with HTTP 401, HTTP 502, and no connectivity each return the matching `Err` and a GhStatus with `ok=False`.

## Validation
- `cd apps/atm-bd-console && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src tests`

dependencies.title: bh-6: tick rules: snapshot, holds, problems, agent status, metrics, stops
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
All business logic in one place, pure: `tick(inputs, state, now, spec) -> (Snapshot, actions, State)` and `due(state, phase, github_mode, now) -> Due` (signatures in bh-1). No I/O, no source strings, no import of atm_bd or any source module (`spec` is bh-1's injected `SpecFn`); the app and the cron call the same function (ANC-001..003).

## Deliverables
1. Agents: one AgentView per member in roster order with all open tasks as Rows (state, kind, difficulty, tag, age) and status (ANC-021): `blocked` presence blocked; `offline` offline/unknown with a task; `busy` active with a task; `stalling` idle with a task; `idle` no task. Markers (ANC-009): red when the task's step has no top_epic or a top_epic other than the root; yellow when the task has no bead.
2. Dispatch (`dispatch.py`): candidates are ready sanity/QA steps, not anchor, not quick_fix, no open task with the bead id; recipient `RepoConfig.sanity_member` or `.qa_member`. Holds (ANC-004), each one flat check: not ready, branch not in remote refs, no worktree, merge state conflict. A held bead is a Section row with its reason; a sent one is an `assign` Action with `spec(DispatchContext)` built per bh-4's field-source table; an `Err` from `spec` is a Snapshot error and no Action. PR and CI never hold.
3. Problems (ANC-010): holds, merge conflicts (to the step's assignee, naming the files; ANC-015), a pushed step with no matching PR (to the assignee; ANC-006) — only from a GitHub read that returned `Ok` this cycle, never when mode is `off` or the read is `Err` (ANC-017) — and CI failure on the stack top's head only (to the lead; ANC-016). Each problem has one recipient. Each new problem -> its own `send` to its recipient at once; per recipient, unresolved ones -> one `batch` 10 min after that recipient's first send of the cycle and every 10 min (`State.batch_due`); resolved ones drop out. Agent status never makes a problem.
4. `due`: `fetch` and `github` true once per 10-min cycle (github false in `off` mode), fetch also when a candidate's branch is not in `State.remotes`; `merges` = every pushed step branch per cycle plus each candidate. Stack top = the open phase PR whose head is no other open phase PR's base; PR match by branch. `Snapshot.prs` = one PrRow per open phase PR in layer order (layer and bead from the matched step, `top`, last Merge).
5. Stops (ANC-011): root closed -> `stopped="closed"`, no actions; no ready and no in_progress step for 60 min -> `stopped="idle"`, no actions; the clock restarts on any ready or in_progress step. A stopped snapshot is the only notice (it shows in `show`, the app and the cron's JSON line).
6. Metrics (ANC-019): done = closed dev+fix steps; total = all dev+fix steps + for each unfinished sprint max(0, round(avg findings per closed sprint) - its findings); pct; active_s = union of step claimed_at..closed_at (now when open) intervals. `Snapshot.sprints` and Mermaid `graph TD` source of the sprints (icon ✅ closed, 🌀 in progress, 📥 ready, ⏳ not ready; id, title, current step and assignee; one edge per depends_on). `Snapshot.sent` = the last 5 Actions; `bead_prefix` from RepoConfig.
7. Every read error in Inputs and every `Phase.step_errors` entry becomes a Snapshot error (a rejected bead is never dispatched); the tick still returns a snapshot (ANC-014).

## Does Not Close
- reading Inputs or running Actions (bh-9); drawing (bh-8, bh-10).
dependencies.design:
## Constants (model.py, not flags)
`CYCLE = 10 min`, `IDLE_STOP = 60 min`. Times are UTC datetimes; nothing here formats local time.

## Headless JSON line (bh-1 `ActionLine`, one per Action/hold/dry_run; errors as `{"at","kind":"error","text"}`; written by bh-9)
```json
{"at":"2026-10-14T16:31:02Z","kind":"hold","to":null,"bead":"atm-bh-6.group-qa","text":"merge conflict with sprint/bh-5-git-github-source: model.py"}
```

Tick goldens (tests/fixtures/tick/) are this sprint's own, written by hand from the rules above.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) Roster fixture with one member per AgentStatus yields that status; planted foreign-epic, broken-chain and no-bead tasks get the right markers; a sprint container task gets none.
- [ ] (D2) Each hold alone holds a candidate with its reason; a red CI, a missing PR and a layer above hold nothing; a fake `spec` returning `Err` gives a Snapshot error and no Action; the assign Action goes to the configured sanity or QA member.
- [ ] (D3) Problems at 1m/2m/3m for the lead and one at 2m for an assignee -> sends at 1m, 2m, 2m, 3m; batches at 11m and 21m to the lead and at 12m to the assignee; resolved ones drop; restoring State from JSON neither resends nor resets.
- [ ] (D3) Only the stack top's failing CI makes a problem, addressed to the lead; a failing lower layer makes none; a conflict message names the files and goes to the assignee; a pushed step without a PR makes a problem after an `Ok` read and none with mode `off` or an `Err` read.
- [ ] (D4) `due` at t=0, 5m, 10m with and without a candidate missing its remote ref; `github=False` in off mode; Snapshot.prs lists the fixture PRs in layer order with exactly one `top`.
- [ ] (D5) Root closed -> stopped closed, no actions; 61 min idle -> stopped idle, no actions; one step in progress for 2 h -> keeps ticking (injected `now`, runs in ms).
- [ ] (D6) Metrics on a fixture of 4 sprints (2 closed with 3 and 1 findings) give the expected N/M, pct and active_s; Mermaid source equals a golden written by hand; `sent` holds the last 5 actions.
- [ ] (D7) An `Err` in every Inputs field and a `Phase.step_errors` entry each yield a Snapshot with that error, no Action for the rejected bead, and no exception.

## Validation
- `cd apps/atm-bd-console && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src tests`

dependencies.title: bh-7: runtime files: JSON state, lock, config, logging
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
Everything the app shows lives in JSON files oversight can read (ANC-022), written safely by one process; settings and logging in one place each.

## Deliverables
1. `state.py`: folder `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/<root>/` (`<root>` = the phase root bead id; writes `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/.gitignore` containing `*` once): `lock`, `snapshot.json`, `state.json`, `merge.json`, `prs.json` written temp+rename with `to_json`, each exactly bh-1's detail-file type; `actions.jsonl` appended one `ActionLine` per line. Every writer returns `Result[None]` (`Err(IoFailed)` with the path and fix, never raises). `acquire_lock()` takes an OS advisory lock (`fcntl.flock`, non-blocking; macOS and Linux) on `lock`, held for the process's life and released by the OS when it dies, so a held lock always means a live holder: no stale-lock takeover exists. It returns `Ok` or `Err(LockHeld(snapshot_age_s))` (None when no snapshot exists); only the holder writes. Readers (`load_snapshot`, `load_state`, `load_prs`, `load_merges`) return `Result`; a missing file is `Err(NotFound)`.
2. `config.py` builds bh-1's `Config` from `.atm-bd/console.toml` `[console]` with `github = "graphql" | "rest" | "off"` (default graphql) and `interval` seconds (default 60, minimum 10); a missing file means all defaults; CLI flags `--github`, `--interval`, `--dry-run`, `--no-fetch` override it; returns `Result[Config]`, `Err(ConfigInvalid)` naming the key, the value and the allowed values (ANC-018).
3. `log.py`: one sc-observability logger per process under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/logs/` (`create_logger(LoggerConfig(service="atm-bd-console", log_root=...))`); `event(action, **fields)` with actions `tick_start`, `tick_end`, `read` (source, duration_ms, ok), `github_read` (mode, ok), `action`, `hold`, `error`; times UTC; never writes to stdout or stderr.
